[b][size=xx-large][color=#ffffff][u]Hack Forum News - Edition 29[/u][/color][/size][/b]

[b]Welcome back to the Hack Forum News. Where we keep you up to date on the weekly events and news happening on site and around the world. If you have never heard of the Hack Forum News, don't worry, we have you covered. We are a team of members from the Hack Forums community who are journalists and writers, and we are here to keep you in the loop of the changes around the site and the events happening around the world.[/b]

[hr]

[b][i]The new year is here, and we want to welcome everyone to 2026. The year is early, but this is going to be our first full year. Everyone can enjoy the content we make for you, all from the team. We rebuilt the HF news last year and everyone has enjoyed us for the last half of 2025 and this year we will be giving everything we got for you all. We cant wait to see what 2026 has to offer for us, and we plan on making sure 2026 gives everyone everything it has to offer you all. We cant thank everyone enough for the support we got throughout 2025 and we cant believe how far we have gone in the last six months. Let us start the year by giving everyone what they came here for. Please enjoy the read.[/i][/b]

[hr]

[img]https://hackforums.net/images/hfnews/headlines-red.png[/img]
[size=medium][b]Writer -[/b][/size] [mention=2331053]

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6316153][color=#ffffff]Happy New Year 2026[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=1]

The new year is here, and the site has had a little makeover to fit the season this year with a lovely new background and a new header image for 2026. With the changes, everyone has been sharing the love and joy for the new year. We can almost still hear the fireworks from everyone in the thread, can you?

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6314337][color=#ffffff]The Hack Forums Wiki Returns[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=2331053]

The Hack Forums Wiki has returned. The site has been under some work recently as the site was sadly left with a load of issues and no one was running the official site. Thanks to everyone within the HF news team, the site is now under new leadership and, thanks to [mention=1] allowing the team to start their work on this while maintaining the HF news, the site is back getting some lovely changes and getting updated daily to bring it back to a new modern day Wikipedia with a load of information for everyone to read up on.

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6299866][color=#ffffff]Hack Forums News Team - Become a Writer[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=2331053]

Are you looking to join the HF news team? Do you enjoy making threads or even want to become a better writer? Well, we are looking for members of the site to help write each week and are looking for anyone who has any interest. We have a few new sections opening up right now, and we would love for you to see if they would be anything of interest to you. If you are interested, please check out the thread or contact [mention=2331053] to discuss joining the team behind the HF News.

[size=medium][b]Writer - [/b][/size] [mention=5465469]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]China mandates 50% domestic equipment rule for chipmakers[/color][/size][/b][/u]  
China will require chipmakers that seek to build or expand facilities to use at least half of their production equipment from domestic manufacturers, a significant step toward reducing reliance on foreign semiconductor tools.  
[b][url=https://www.reuters.com/world/china/china-mandates-50-domestic-equipment-rule-chipmakers-sources-say-2025-12-30/]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]US approves Samsung and SK Hynix chipmaking tool shipments to China for 2026[/color][/size][/b][/u]  
The United States government granted annual licences to Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix to import chipmaking equipment to their Chinese facilities for 2026, replacing prior broad export waivers.  
[b][url=https://www.reuters.com/world/china/samsung-wins-us-annual-approval-chipmaking-tool-shipments-china-source-says-2025-12-30/]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]Amphenol stock slips in year end tech pullback affecting hardware firms[/color][/size][/b][/u]  
Shares of Amphenol, a maker of connectors and data communications hardware, declined slightly as a broader pullback in tech spending weighed on related equities.  
[b][url=https://www.ts2.tech/en/amphenol-stock-slips-in-year-end-tech-pullback-fed-minutes-and-housing-data-loom/]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]KLA Corp stock drops on tech pullback affecting chip equipment names[/color][/size][/b][/u]  
KLA Corp saw its stock fall as broader technology equities softened in thin year-end trading, reflecting investor caution in semiconductor equipment sectors.  
[b][url=https://www.ts2.tech/en/kla-stock-drops-after-tech-pullback-hits-chip-equipment-names-fed-minutes-next/]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]Nvidia slips in premarket trading after Intel filing confirms $5B stake purchase[/color][/size][/b][/u]  
Nvidia shares fell about 1% in premarket trading as Intel disclosed that Nvidia’s $5 billion stake purchase was completed, affecting AI hardware stock sentiment.  
[b][url=https://www.ts2.tech/en/ai-stocks-today-nvidia-slips-premarket-after-intel-filing-confirms-5b-stake/]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]CES 2026 preview shows future of AI robotics, wearables and industrial gadgets[/color][/size][/b][/u]  
CES 2026 preparations highlight an increased focus on AI robotics, wearable devices and advanced industrial hardware, with major companies set to showcase the latest innovations.  
[b][url=https://www.investors.com/news/technology/ces-2026-preview-ai-humanoids-wearables/]Source[/url][/b]

[/align]
